talents.e: Life Tap grants a larger Mana bonus, up to twenty percent more.
Adds hit chance while cutting threat you generate by a fifth.
Corruption casts faster and deals ten percent more damage.
All your Warlock damage over time gains five percent more damage.
Killing a Drain Soul target doubles Mana regen, even while casting.
Drain Life, Drain Soul and Wrack deal twenty percent more damage or drain.
Bane of Agony deals ten percent more damage.
Seventy percent chance to ignore damage interruption while channeling or casting drains.
Your next curse hits harder for thirty seconds, with a short cooldown.
Doubles the critical damage bonus of several damage over time spells.
Shadow spells gain five percent extra chance for critical effects.
Four percent chance for a Shadow Trance that makes your next Shadow Bolt instant.
Slows the target's movement by thirty percent for twelve seconds.
Steals eleven health from the target every three seconds for thirty seconds.
Each other Affliction effect on the target boosts drains and Wrack, capped at 36%.
Shadow spells deal five percent more damage and drain more health.
Inflicts Shadow damage every second and amplifies your other Shadow damage over time.
Health Funnel transfers more health for less cost and generates no threat.
Imp Firebolt and Fire Shield gain thirty percent more power.
Raises your total Stamina by fifteen percent.
Your Imp and other demons deal ten percent more damage.
Demon Skin and Demon Armor become thirty percent more effective.
Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice and Suffering gain thirty percent effectiveness.
Demons gain fifteen percent more health and Mana, and you gain fifteen percent Mana.
Heal your pet for fifteen percent of spell damage, and Life Tap feeds it Mana.
Succubus and Incubus spells gain thirty percent more effect and duration.
Sacrifices your demon for a two-hour buff that depends on its type.
Demon summons cast four seconds faster and cost forty percent less Mana.
Soul Fire cooldown drops ninety percent, and low-health targets take more damage.
Your next demon summon casts much faster and costs half the Mana.
Searing Pain brands the target so your pet's six strikes hit harder.
Felhunter abilities gain thirty percent more effect and Spell Lock cools down six seconds faster.
Thirty percent of your damage taken goes to your demon, and both deal more damage.
While a demon is out, spell damage rises by up to your level for both of you.
Warlock and demon gain a type-based bonus of up to ten percent.
Summoning a different demon no longer cancels your Demonic Sacrifice effect.
Your damaging spells gain twenty percent more range.
Shadow Bolt critical strikes increase Shadow damage the target takes from you by twenty percent.
Shadow Bolt, Immolate and Incinerate cast half a second faster, Soul Fire two seconds faster.
Reduces all damage you take by ten percent.
Your Destruction spells cost ten percent less Mana.
Immolate's initial damage grows by half, and Conflagrate always dazes the target.
Destruction critical strikes deal double their usual bonus damage.
Instant Shadow blast; killing a non-trivial target within eight seconds grants a Soul Shard.
Seventy percent chance to resist damage interruption while casting Destruction spells.
Searing Pain crits rise, and all Destruction spells deal ten percent more damage.
Consumes your Immolate on an afflicted target to deal Fire damage.
Soul Fire, Rain of Fire and Hellfire gain a twenty-six percent chance to stun.
Curses target so fifteen percent of your damage to others also hits them for five minutes.
Conflagrate critical strike chance rises by twenty-five percent.
Conflagrate and Shadowburn boost Shadow and Fire damage, and sometimes spare Immolate or refund shards.
Fire damage spell that deals extra damage when the target has Immolate.
